system_thesis_interpretation: This is not a test of memory, autonomous learning, final-task performance, or an architecture. It is a small deterministic-interface development experiment asking whether a THINK_0-derived coordinate, used only by trusted code to allocate sixteen later public views, changes the same base model's append-only provisional proposals. The scientifically meaningful contrast is therefore an intervention on provider-visible evidence allocation after a common prefix, conditional on six named aligned development lives. The proposal deserves credit for excluding online truth, freezing raw proposals before scoring, exposing connector-equality assistance, separating four closure definitions, and refusing statistical or follow-up authority. However, the current design does not yet isolate that intervention: post-branch sampling seeds depend on physical call slots, while the purported pre-provider exchangeability computation requires model-produced MEMORY_0 and a THINK_0-derived frontier. As written, arm differences can be caused by different stochastic streams, and the temporal precommit claim is impossible. Recommendation: REWORK before ratification, implementation, sync, or GPU execution. After the blockers below are repaired and rebound, one bounded run of at most 904 DREAM plus 72 THINK calls can be worth the H100 cost strictly as an interface/measurement calibration, not as evidence for the broader thesis.
graph_delta_interpretation: The proposed graph has an unusually good irreversible downstream structure: shared cognition precedes branch allocation; provisional writes freeze before a separate scorer imports target truth or normalization; an independent verifier, transitive closure, identical dual reviews, and a human stop surround the run. The causal graph nevertheless needs two corrections. First, exchangeability and target construction cannot precede every provider call because MEMORY_0 is produced by 514 shared DREAM calls and the own frontier is optionally produced by THINK_0. The honest edge is shared DREAM -> MEMORY_0 -> THINK_0/frontier -> post-prefix precommit/matching -> branch DREAM, with integrity failure at that point preventing branch and exploratory calls but not erasing already consumed prefix calls. Second, physical_call_slot -> decoding_seed -> proposal is an open backdoor from arm execution position to outcome because arm determines physical slot. Corresponding arm calls must use an arm-independent logical-slot seed (common random numbers), while physical slots remain unique accounting identifiers; otherwise allocation is not the only changed parent of proposal bytes. The graph must also explicitly define no-frontier and fewer-than-sixteen-view states, because both currently leave a fixed 288-call branch graph without defined inputs.
loop_delta_interpretation: Physically sharing the 514-call prefix and cloning its exact MEMORY_0/THINK_0 state is a sound way to avoid pseudoreplicating the common history. The 288 post-branch calls are the actual experimental interventions; the 802-call total is arithmetically consistent (four seed-0/2 lives at 132 plus two seed-1 lives at 137), and the six full-context plus ninety-six RAG calls correctly total 102 exploratory calls. THINK is a terminal-justified prefix of at most 72 rather than padded calls. But a closed loop is missing for two foreseeable runtime outcomes: THINK_0 may DEFER/fail and yield no coordinate, and an OUT_OF_STRATUM universe may contain fewer than sixteen distinct candidates although sixteen calls per arm remain mandatory. Rework must predeclare whether either event stops before branching with sunk-call accounting, or how exactly legal distinct views are supplied without replacement, resampling, target adaptation, or synthetic evidence. It must also order or interleave branch calls independently of arm semantics and match logical decoding seeds across corresponding slots. Exploratory calls should occur only if the primary branch remains defined; spending 102 ceiling calls after an undefined primary estimand would not be useful.
claim_delta_interpretation: The population is exactly six named aligned development lives, formed by three seeds and their collision twins. Twins are diagnostic paired cases, not six independent samples, and the EXACT/NEAR strata can contain zero eligible lives. Thus no p-value, confidence interval, population frequency, reliability, robustness, general recurrence, learning, discovery, final behavior, compute efficiency, or architecture comparison is identified. Own-minus-no-feedback describes a policy-package contrast; own-minus-distractor can more narrowly probe coordinate-specific allocation only if all arms are scored against the same own target and exogenous decoding randomness is matched. The word 'changed' has a causal reading and is justified only after that repair; under current bytes the strongest honest verb is 'differed'. Even after repair, the result is a within-six-calibration counterfactual observation. A positive closure count can arise from typed endpoint fields, exposed shared-C equality, the output schema, literal relation text, normalization, repeated proposal opportunities, or model composition. A negative result can arise from DEFER, schema/token rejection, insufficient selected opportunity, or stochastic decoding. Reporting all these mechanisms is necessary, but none promotes the experiment beyond interface development.
visibility_matrix_interpretation: The intended visibility boundary is scientifically conservative: target, arm, rank, stratum, final behavior, truth, allowlist, and scores are excluded from live provider bytes; selected redacted public structure and bounded provisional memory are visible; scorer-only truth is unlocked after MEMORY_1. Equal C aliases deliberately reveal connector equality, so success is not independent discovery and must be interpreted as composition from treatment-mediated structured evidence. The selector-provider byte invariance and raw-ID scans are necessary but not sufficient shortcut controls: visible view order, endpoint frequency, alias multiplicity, shared-C pattern, lexical texture, and schema position may still identify the allocation policy or make closure mechanically compilable. The 1000-pair audit must report such survivors, not merely forbidden private fields. It should additionally bind the arm-independent logical seed/config bytes and demonstrate that any arm byte differences are exhausted by the selected rendered view. Scorer access to the own target must be explicit and identical across all three arm score packets; otherwise visibility separation is preserved but the arm estimand silently changes.
acceptance_test_interpretation: All twenty-one tests are necessary, but passing future code tests cannot cure an underdefined estimand. (1) t_v2b_scope_excludes_final_behavior_and_lora correctly enforces the narrow non-final scope. (2) t_v2b_h100_qwen_exact_environment must additionally distinguish unique physical session/receipt IDs from an identical arm-independent logical decoding seed for corresponding post-branch slots and test branch-order invariance. (3) t_v2b_candidate_universe_integrity_states correctly separates legitimate absence from broken computation, but must assert when the state is computed and account for already-consumed prefix/THINK calls. (4) t_v2b_exact_exchangeability_formulas must test the exact distractor-coordinate selection universe and tie rule, same-own-target scoring, and set-level rather than accidentally single-view mechanical opportunity. (5) t_v2b_zero_eligible_no_pool_or_go is essential and scientifically adequate. (6) t_v2b_connector_alias_derivation_and_redaction is strong; it must retain shared-C as an explicitly visible shortcut rather than treating aliasing as blindness. (7) t_v2b_selector_provider_byte_separation must compare complete request and decoding config bytes, including the repaired logical seed, and allow differences only from rendered selected content. (8) t_v2b_ascii_json_and_256_token_legality correctly prevents repair and hidden output normalization, while rejection rates must be outcomes, not silently missing data. (9) t_v2b_provisional_append_only_no_online_signal is essential to block rejection-sampling and verifier feedback. (10) t_v2b_schedule_802_72_102_and_cardinalities currently exposes a specification blocker: it needs explicit expected cardinalities for DEFER/failure and fewer-than-sixteen candidate states before it can assert 802/288. (11) t_v2b_exact_provider_and_experiment_ledgers is necessary and must ledger common-random-number logical slots separately from unique physical calls and shared-call arm attribution. (12) t_v2b_memory1_scorer_import_barrier is strong and should test that importing scorer modules is impossible in every runner subprocess, not only that APIs deny reads. (13) t_v2b_four_closure_metrics_and_normalization_gain is scientifically useful; it must assert all arms use the same own target outcome and report proposal opportunity denominators, unique semantic closures, duplicates, any-closure, and first post-branch closure. (14) t_v2b_deterministic_no_model_controls is not yet a true ceiling test: controls need the same visible inputs, legal output schema, per-slot opportunity accounting, and comparable aggregation; query_copy_ceiling and public_witness_oracle must remain privileged scorer-side bounds and must never be subtracted as if they estimate model-free contribution. (15) t_v2b_1000_pair_exact_byte_shortcut_audit should fail on forbidden private leakage but report, stratify, and qualify claims for every allowed visible survivor, including shared-C, alias count, endpoint position, lexical cues, and renderer templates. (16) t_v2b_exploratory_ceilings_not_matched_baselines correctly forbids causal, efficiency, memory, recurrence, and superiority comparisons; ceilings should be skipped if the primary arm estimand is undefined. (17) t_v2b_complete_independent_artifact_graph is essential and must include sunk prefix calls and terminal reasons for every scientifically undefined branch, not force a fabricated complete run. (18) t_v2b_transitive_freeze_and_resource_closure is a sound execution-integrity test, not a scientific-validity substitute. (19) t_v2b_identical_inspectable_dual_review correctly requires exact identical evidence and independent approval after the repaired bytes exist. (20) t_v2b_durable_remote_markers is operationally adequate if restart never regenerates seeds, aliases, selections, or provider calls. (21) t_v2b_exact_human_scope_and_unconditional_stop correctly preserves Rohin's authority; ratification must bind a revised package, not these scientifically blocked bytes. No current test has executed, because the named v2b implementation and test files are intentionally future artifacts.
assumptions: A physical call slot differs across arms for corresponding RETURN_SLEEP rounds under the declared 288-call branch schedule, so a seed containing physical_call_slot is not common across arms.
MEMORY_0 is an observed product of the 514 shared DREAM provider calls rather than a generator-only object available before those calls.
The own projected frontier may be absent because the THINK_0 contract explicitly permits DEFER, failure, or exhaustion without REQUEST_DREAM.

The primary arm outcome is intended to be closure of the same own q in no_feedback, own_selector, and matched_distractor; if instead each arm has a different scored q, there is no arm-level closure estimand.
Deterministic controls operate once per life/arm on selected-view bytes and do not automatically share the model's sixteen sequential proposal opportunities or evolving provisional-memory state.
No inference beyond the six named development lives is intended, and the two collision twins within each seed are paired diagnostics rather than independent population draws.

ambiguities.question: Does 'before any provider call' mean before the entire job or only before the first post-branch DREAM call, given that both MEMORY_0 and the optional own frontier require provider calls?
ambiguities.impact: The current literal ordering is impossible and misstates which integrity failures can prevent all GPU spend versus only further branch spend.

ambiguities.question: What exact arm inputs, schedule, state, and estimand apply when THINK_0 terminates with DEFER, malformed output, failure, or twelve calls without a valid REQUEST_DREAM coordinate?
ambiguities.impact: The own_selector and matched_distractor arms are undefined while the artifact graph still requires eighteen branches and 288 selector traces.

ambiguities.question: How are sixteen RETURN_SLEEP calls executed without replacement or padding when a legitimate OUT_OF_STRATUM universe yields fewer than sixteen distinct selected candidates?
ambiguities.impact: The selector definition and fixed 802-call schedule cannot both hold as written.

ambiguities.question: What frozen universe, exclusion rule, matching objective, and final tie key choose the single recipient-local same-kind distractor coordinate?
ambiguities.impact: Exact metric formulas classify a given pair but do not by themselves make distractor choice reproducible or protect against researcher-selected matches.

ambiguities.question: Are all three arm proposals scored against the same own q, with the distractor coordinate affecting only selected evidence?
ambiguities.impact: If targets vary by arm, count differences mix evidence allocation with different outcome definitions and are not paired effects.

ambiguities.question: Does mechanical closure opportunity require witnesses across the union of all sixteen selected views, or all four witness kinds inside one candidate view?
ambiguities.impact: The text uses both a per-candidate selector feature and a selected-set definition; different readings change rankings, strata, and eligible lives.

ambiguities.question: What common opportunity denominator makes a sixteen-call evolving model count comparable to a once-per-life deterministic construction, and are duplicate model proposals counted repeatedly?
ambiguities.impact: Without a common unit, model-minus-max-control is numerically reproducible but not a compiler-adjusted residual or ceiling comparison.

ambiguities.question: What precommitted physical order executes arms, and is decoding invariant to that order after logical seeds are matched?
ambiguities.impact: Fixed arm order can couple arm to thermal/runtime nondeterminism or residual provider state even when declared caches are reset.

disagreements_with_proposal.statement: Reject the claim that own/distractor exchangeability is computed before every provider call.
disagreements_with_proposal.rationale: The computation consumes frozen MEMORY_0 and the own q, which exist only after shared DREAM and THINK_0 provider calls. A fail-closed implementation cannot satisfy the literal graph.
disagreements_with_proposal.proposed_resolution: Split static pre-provider integrity from post-prefix/pre-branch matching. State that post-prefix INTEGRITY_FAILURE stops all remaining branch/exploratory calls, preserve and report sunk prefix/THINK calls, and remove every assertion that it prevented calls already required to construct its inputs.

disagreements_with_proposal.statement: Do not accept physical-call-slot-derived stochastic seeds for causal arm contrasts.
disagreements_with_proposal.rationale: At DREAM temperature 0.2, arm-specific physical slots cause different random streams. Proposal differences then reflect both view allocation and decoding randomness, so the allocation effect is not identified in a single trajectory per arm.
disagreements_with_proposal.proposed_resolution: Define a separate arm-independent logical seed from frozen run, life, stage, logical round, and corresponding slot; use it in every arm for the matched RETURN_SLEEP call. Keep physical slot only in unique receipts/accounting. Precommit arm execution order or deterministic interleaving and test order invariance.

disagreements_with_proposal.statement: Do not simultaneously require an optional frontier, all legitimate shortages to run, exactly sixteen distinct views, 288 selector traces, and exactly 802 recurrent calls without defining terminal behavior.
disagreements_with_proposal.rationale: DEFER/failure can remove q, and fewer than sixteen candidates cannot populate sixteen distinct selector slots under the no-replacement rule.
disagreements_with_proposal.proposed_resolution: Choose and bind one policy for each state. Scientifically preferred: stop before branching when no valid frontier exists and label the life PRIMARY_UNDEFINED; for a short universe either stop that life before branching or predeclare a content-free missing-view call shape. Recompute allowed call cardinalities and artifact requirements from terminal manifests rather than claiming unconditional 802. Do not resample targets or duplicate evidence.

disagreements_with_proposal.statement: The exact outcome target and distractor-selection rule must be explicit before calling own-minus-distractor a paired allocation contrast.
disagreements_with_proposal.rationale: The package specifies matching metrics but not a complete distractor choice algorithm, and it does not state unambiguously in the scoring section that every arm is evaluated against the same own q.
disagreements_with_proposal.proposed_resolution: Freeze the candidate coordinate universe, exclusion predicate, lexicographic match objective, and semantic-hash tie break before branch outcomes. Bind the same own q in every arm scorer packet; the distractor q may affect only trusted selection. Add fixtures for multiple equally matched distractors and wrong arm-specific scorer targets.

disagreements_with_proposal.statement: EXACT and NEAR should be called measured-balance strata, not exchangeability states.
disagreements_with_proposal.rationale: Equality on counts, positions, ranks, endpoint frequency, opportunity, and token Jaccard does not establish exchangeability of semantic content, renderer cues, or all causes of closure. With three preselected pairs it is a diagnostic match, not probabilistic exchangeability.
disagreements_with_proposal.proposed_resolution: Rename the interpretation in prose to exact/near measured-balance strata, retain outcome-independent formulas, publish every visible imbalance and shortcut survivor, and prohibit language that treats matching as randomization or removes residual confounding.

disagreements_with_proposal.statement: Do not interpret model_count minus the maximum deterministic-control count as compiler-adjusted model contribution.
disagreements_with_proposal.rationale: The controls have privileged and heterogeneous inputs, run once rather than through sixteen evolving model slots, and include query-copy and public-oracle constructions unavailable to cognition. A maximum over incomparable opportunity counts is not a ceiling estimator; repeated model proposals can exceed a one-output control mechanically.
disagreements_with_proposal.proposed_resolution: Keep each control as a separately labeled sufficiency/opportunity diagnostic. Add common per-life/arm outcomes such as any closure, unique semantic closure, first post-branch closure, and closure per legal proposal opportunity; where feasible run schema-legal compiler controls per selected slot with the same visible inputs. Report model-control differences only for exactly common units and never call the privileged query-copy/oracle subtraction latent reasoning.

disagreements_with_proposal.statement: The current strongest permitted sentence is too causal because it says allocation 'changed' proposals.
disagreements_with_proposal.rationale: Under the current seed schedule allocation is not the sole manipulated cause, and low-dimensional matching does not remove semantic differences. The population is only three selected collision pairs.
disagreements_with_proposal.proposed_resolution: Until common-random-number and same-target repairs land, replace 'changed' with 'was associated with different'. After repair, permit 'changed' only for the exact within-life intervention and retain every existing nonclaim. Explicitly state that twins are paired cases and that stratum summaries are not population inference.

disagreements_with_proposal.statement: Do not spend the bounded H100 run on the current package bytes.
disagreements_with_proposal.rationale: Up to 976 provider calls would produce an expensive but causally ambiguous result, and undefined DEFER/short-universe states may make the primary estimand unavailable after substantial sunk prefix compute.
disagreements_with_proposal.proposed_resolution: Rework and rebind the design first. A single GPU run becomes worthwhile only after all twenty-one tests plus new matched-seed, no-frontier, short-universe, same-target, distractor-choice, and control-denominator fixtures pass; both independent reviewers approve identical revised bytes; exact human ratification follows; and pre-GPU manifests show a defined branch policy and bounded maximum spend. Treat any resulting run only as interface calibration.

open_questions: Will Rohin require a revised standalone v2c-equivalent package that resolves the temporal precommit, matched-randomness, undefined-branch, same-target, distractor-choice, and compiler-denominator blockers before considering exact ratification?
After those repairs, does Rohin judge at most 904 DREAM and 72 THINK calls on one H100 NVL worth the cost solely for six-life interface calibration, with no automatic follow-up or broader claim?

If THINK_0 yields no frontier or a selected universe has fewer than sixteen views, does Rohin prefer a terminal primary-undefined stop with sunk-call reporting, or a newly specified content-free branch protocol?

No implementation, provider call, GPU sync, execution, repair run, replication, heldout access, LoRA, claim promotion, external action, or second run is authorized by this interpretation or by the current proposal state.
